Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: Great Sacrifice
Cards.Text: Battle: Destroy your performing unbowed Personality and target an enemy unit with total Force equal to or lower than your performer's Force, plus Personal Honor, plus one if he is defending: Destroy the enemy unit.

Cards.Name: On the Hunt
Cards.Text:
Battle: Choose your performing Samurai: Attach an attachment in your hand to him, paying all costs but paying 4 less Gold.
Open: Choose your performing Samurai with an attachment: Straighten his unit.

Cards.Name: Tireless Efforts
Cards.Text:
Battle: Choose your performing Personality: Straighten him.
Battle/Open: Choose your performing Personality: Negate all current and new Force penalties on him.

Cards.Name: Costly Opportunity
Cards.Text: Battle: Destroy your target performing unbowed Samurai to target an enemy card without attachments. Abilities on other cards now in its unit may not be used. Destroy the targeted card.

Cards.Name: Silent Terror
Cards.Text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Ninja Personality and target an enemy card: Bow it. You may discard a card in the current battlefield's province.

Cards.Name: Goju Plot
Cards.Text: Battle: Destroy your performing Shadowlands Ninja Personality and target a Ninja Personality in your discard pile: Bring him into play at the current battlefield, paying all costs but reducing his Gold cost to enter play by the performer's Gold Cost. Lose 2 Honor. You may take an additional Battle action.

Cards.Name: Discovering a Conspiracy
Cards.Text:
As a Focus Effect, after this duel ends, if your Personality won it, gain 2 Honor.
Political Battle/Open: Target your performing unbowed Magistrate to target a Personality. His lord casts him out for treachery. Permanently remove his Clan Alignment keywords. Dishonor him. If he is at a battlefield, bow him and choose a player, who gains or loses 1 Honor.

Cards.Name: Insulting Gesture
Cards.Text:
Political Open: Choose your performing unbowed Courtier. Take the Imperial Favor.
Favor Political Battle: Discard the Imperial Favor to target an enemy Personality. Dishonor him. Bow him. Move him home. His controller loses 2 Honor.

Cards.Name: Barred Passage
Cards.Text: Heroic Battle: Target your performing unbowed Hero, who must be the only Personality in his army, to target an enemy Personality and bow his unit.

Cards.Name: A Fugitive Apprehended
Cards.Text: Battle: Target your performing unbowed Personality. Bow a target enemy card without attachments and with lower Gold Cost. If your Personality is a Magistrate, you may target an enemy card and reduce its Gold Cost to 0.

Cards.Name: Dislodge the Foe
Cards.Text: Battle: Target one or more of your performing Tacticians at the same, non-current battlefield to target a Personality opposing them. He is lured into a trap. Move the targets to the current battlefield.

Cards.Name: Know No Fear
Cards.Text:
Reaction: After another player's action targets your performing Samurai: Negate his bowing and movement from the action's effects.
Reaction: After a Fear action targets your performing Samurai: Negate its effects.

Cards.Name: To First Blood
Cards.Text:
As a Focus Effect: Negate any destruction for losing this duel. After this duel ends, its winner's controller gains 2 Honor.
Reaction: After another player's Iaijutsu action targets your Personality: Negate his destruction from the action's effects.
